/* PdaCargoMapper.selectPkgInfo : 화물 조회 - 화물 기본 박스 정보 조회 */ SELECT PACKING_NO, TBI.IN_NO, ISNULL(TBI.OD_JOB_NO, TBIP.OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO, ISNULL(TBI.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, TBIP.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, FORMAT(CAST(TBIPP.BCR_TIME AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') AS BCR_TIME, TBI.BL_NO AS BL_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN TBIP WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN TBI WITH (NOLOCK) ON TBI.IN_PLAN_NO = TBIP.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG TBIPP WITH (NOLOCK) ON TBIPP.IN_PLAN_NO = TBIP.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE PACKING_NO = #{packingNo}
AND TBIPP.SEQ = #{srchSeq}

/* PdaCargoMapper.selectCargoTracking : 화물 조회 */ SELECT '반입예정' AS DATA_TYPE, 0 AS CT, EX_WT AS WT, MGN_ISSUE_YN, VESSEL_FLIGHT, MBL_NO, '' AS LAST_POD_DATE, DELIVERY_NAME, COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, CONSIGNEE_NAME, '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS, '' AS AR_DATE, '' AS AR_TIME, '' AS CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS CARRYIN_TIME, '' AS CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS CARRYOUT_TIME, '' AS APPROVAL_DATE, '' AS APPROVAL_CANCEL_DATE, '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS MOVE_CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS MOVE_CARRYOUT_DATE, CASE WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '마약' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '총기' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품,의약품' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '협업검사' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사(기타)' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '신고인 검사요청' ELSE '' END AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, CASE WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '마약' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '총기' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품,의약품' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '협업검사' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사(기타)' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '신고인 검사요청' ELSE '' END AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, CASE WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '5' THEN '검사(일반/간이)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '6' THEN '검역(사전검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '8' THEN '검역(동물검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '9' THEN '검역(식물검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '10' THEN '검역(식품검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '11' THEN '검역(서류)' ELSE '' END AS INSPECTION_TYPE, ( SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '마약' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '총기' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품,의약품' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '협업검사' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사(기타)' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '신고인 검사요청' ELSE '' END FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = bmsPlan.IN_PLAN_NO ) AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, CASE WHEN CD_TYPE = 'B' THEN '배제' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'E' THEN '이행' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'N' THEN '일반' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'Y' THEN '목록' ELSE '' END AS CD_TYPE, BIG_SIZE_YN, INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, CRIME_SELECTION_YN, INSPECTION_TYPE, INSPECTION_TYPE_A, INSPECTION_TYPE_B, '' AS ALL_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, '' AS LAST_POD_STATUS, ( SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN SUM(IN_CT) = bmsPlan.EX_CT THEN CONCAT(bmsPlan.EX_CT, '') ELSE CONCAT(SUM(IN_CT), '/', bmsPlan.EX_CT) END FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = bmsPlan.IN_PLAN_NO GROUP BY IN_PLAN_NO ) AS CT_PRINT , '' AS REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bmsPlan WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{CARGO_REFERENCE_NO} UNION ALL SELECT '반입' AS DATA_TYPE, CT, WT, MGN_ISSUE_YN, VESSEL_FLIGHT, MBL_NO, LAST_POD_DATE, DELIVERY_NAME, COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, CONSIGNEE_NAME, CASE WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = '999' THEN '로케이션 삭제' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'A' THEN '일반' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'A101' THEN 'A1-01 장기보관' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'B' THEN '취하' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'C' THEN '홀드' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'C101' THEN 'C1-01' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D' THEN '수입신고수리완료' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D00101' THEN 'D0-01-01 체화' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D9-AA' THEN 'D9-AA 파손' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'ETC001' THEN '기타분류위치' ELSE LOCATION_PLACE END AS LOCATION_PLACE, CASE WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS01' THEN '입력' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS02' THEN '송신실패' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS03' THEN '송신' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS04' THEN '접수' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS05' THEN '오류' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS06' THEN '승인' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS07' THEN '거부' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS08' THEN '보류' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMS09' THEN '기각' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMSA1' THEN '타창고하기' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMSA2' THEN '세관검사장' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMSA3' THEN '통관후입고' WHEN LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS = 'BMSA4' THEN '수입통관이고' ELSE '' END AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS, CASE WHEN IN_CLASS = '10' THEN FORMAT(CAST(AR_DATE AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd') ELSE '' END AS AR_DATE, CASE WHEN IN_CLASS = '10' THEN FORMAT(CAST(AR_TIME AS DATETIME), 'HH:mm') ELSE '' END AS AR_TIME, CASE WHEN IN_CLASS = '10' THEN FORMAT(CAST(CARRYIN_DATE AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd') ELSE '' END AS CARRYIN_DATE, CASE WHEN IN_CLASS = '10' THEN FORMAT(CAST(CARRYIN_TIME AS DATETIME), 'HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS CARRYIN_TIME, '' AS CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS CARRYOUT_TIME, '' AS APPROVAL_DATE, '' AS APPROVAL_CANCEL_DATE, '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, CASE WHEN IN_CLASS = '21' THEN FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(CARRYIN_DATE, ' ', CARRYIN_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS MOVE_CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS MOVE_CARRYOUT_DATE, CASE WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '마약' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '총기' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품,의약품' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '협업검사' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사(기타)' WHEN SE_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '신고인 검사요청' ELSE '' END AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, CASE WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '마약' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '총기' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품,의약품' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '협업검사' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사(기타)' WHEN PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '신고인 검사요청' ELSE '' END AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, CASE WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '5' THEN '검사(일반/간이)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '6' THEN '검역(사전검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '8' THEN '검역(동물검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '9' THEN '검역(식물검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '10' THEN '검역(식품검역)' WHEN INSPECTION_TYPE = '11' THEN '검역(서류)' ELSE '' END AS INSPECTION_TYPE, CASE WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '마약' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '총기' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품,의약품' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '협업검사' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사(기타)' WHEN XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '신고인 검사요청' ELSE '' END AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, CASE WHEN CD_TYPE = 'B' THEN '배제' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'E' THEN '이행' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'N' THEN '일반' WHEN CD_TYPE = 'Y' THEN '목록' ELSE '' END AS CD_TYPE, BIG_SIZE_YN, INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, CRIME_SELECTION_YN, INSPECTION_TYPE, INSPECTION_TYPE_A, INSPECTION_TYPE_B, ALL_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, CASE WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS01' THEN '입력' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS02' THEN '송신실패' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS03' THEN '송신' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS04' THEN '접수' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS05' THEN '오류' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS06' THEN '승인' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS07' THEN '거부' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS08' THEN '보류' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS09' THEN '기각' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA1' THEN '타창고하기' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA2' THEN '세관검사장' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA3' THEN '통관후입고' WHEN IN_CLASS <> '21' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA4' THEN '수입통관이고' ELSE '' END AS LAST_POD_STATUS, ( SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN SUM(IN_CT) = bmsIn.EX_CT THEN CONCAT(bmsIn.CT, '') ELSE CONCAT(SUM(IN_CT), '/', bmsIn.CT) END FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IN_PLAN_NO = bmsIn.IN_PLAN_NO GROUP BY IN_PLAN_NO ) AS CT_PRINT , REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN bmsIn WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{CARGO_REFERENCE_NO} UNION ALL SELECT '반출승인' AS DATA_TYPE, 0 AS CT, 0 AS WT, '' AS MGN_ISSUE_YN, VESSEL_FLIGHT, MBL_NO, '' AS LAST_POD_DATE, '' AS DELIVERY_NAME, '' AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '' AS CONSIGNEE_NAME, '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS, '' AS AR_DATE, '' AS AR_TIME, '' AS CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS CARRYIN_TIME, '' AS CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS CARRYOUT_TIME, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND APPROVAL_CLASS = '31' AND ISDATE(NOTIFY_DATE_TIME) = 1 THEN FORMAT(CAST(NOTIFY_DATE_TIME AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS APPROVAL_DATE, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND APPROVAL_CLASS = '1' AND ISDATE(NOTIFY_DATE_TIME) = 1 THEN FORMAT(CAST(NOTIFY_DATE_TIME AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS APPROVAL_CANCEL_DATE, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND ISDATE(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME) = 1 THEN FORMAT(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS MOVE_CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS MOVE_CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS CD_TYPE, '' AS BIG_SIZE_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, '' AS INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, '' AS CRIME_SELECTION_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE_A, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE_B, '' AS ALL_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, '' AS LAST_POD_STATUS, '0' AS CT_PRINT , '' AS REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{CARGO_REFERENCE_NO} UNION ALL SELECT '반출' AS DATA_TYPE, 0 AS CT, 0 AS WT, '' AS MGN_ISSUE_YN, '' AS VESSEL_FLIGHT, MBL_NO, '' AS LAST_POD_DATE, '' AS DELIVERY_NAME, '' AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '' AS CONSIGNEE_NAME, '' AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS, '' AS AR_DATE, '' AS AR_TIME, '' AS CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS CARRYIN_TIME, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' THEN FORMAT(CAST(CARRYOUT_DATE AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd') ELSE '' END AS CARRYOUT_DATE, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' THEN FORMAT(CAST(CARRYOUT_TIME AS DATETIME), 'HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS CARRYOUT_TIME, '' AS APPROVAL_DATE, '' AS APPROVAL_CANCEL_DATE, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND ISDATE(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME) = 1 THEN FORMAT(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS MOVE_CARRYIN_DATE, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS = '61' AND OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND ISDATE(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME) = 1 THEN FORMAT(OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') ELSE '' END AS MOVE_CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS CD_TYPE, '' AS BIG_SIZE_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, '' AS INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, '' AS CRIME_SELECTION_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE_A, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE_B, '' AS ALL_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, CASE WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS01' THEN '입력' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS02' THEN '송신실패' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS03' THEN '송신' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS04' THEN '접수' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS05' THEN '오류' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS06' THEN '승인' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS07' THEN '거부' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS08' THEN '보류' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMS09' THEN '기각' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA1' THEN '타창고하기' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA2' THEN '세관검사장' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA3' THEN '통관후입고' WHEN OUT_CLASS <> '61' AND LAST_POD_STATUS = 'BMSA4' THEN '수입통관이고' ELSE '' END AS LAST_POD_STATUS, '0' AS CT_PRINT , '' AS REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{CARGO_REFERENCE_NO} UNION ALL SELECT 'BOX' AS DATA_TYPE, 0 AS CT, 0 AS WT, '' AS MGN_ISSUE_YN, '' AS VESSEL_FLIGHT, '' AS MBL_NO, '' AS LAST_POD_DATE, '' AS DELIVERY_NAME, '' AS COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC, '' AS CONSIGNEE_NAME, CASE WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = '999' THEN '로케이션 삭제' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'A' THEN '일반' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'A101' THEN 'A1-01 장기보관' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'B' THEN '취하' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'C' THEN '홀드' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'C101' THEN 'C1-01' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D' THEN '수입신고수리완료' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D00101' THEN 'D0-01-01 체화' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'D9-AA' THEN 'D9-AA 파손' WHEN LOCATION_PLACE = 'ETC001' THEN '기타분류위치' ELSE LOCATION_PLACE END AS LOCATION_PLACE, '' AS LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS, '' AS AR_DATE, '' AS AR_TIME, '' AS CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS CARRYIN_TIME, '' AS CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS CARRYOUT_TIME, '' AS APPROVAL_DATE, '' AS APPROVAL_CANCEL_DATE, '' AS OUT_SCAN_DATE_TIME, '' AS MOVE_CARRYIN_DATE, '' AS MOVE_CARRYOUT_DATE, '' AS SE_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE, '' AS CD_TYPE, '' AS BIG_SIZE_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_CUSTOMS_YN, '' AS INTELLECTUAL_PROP_YN, '' AS CRIME_SELECTION_YN, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE_A, '' AS INSPECTION_TYPE_B, '' AS ALL_INSPECTION_FINISH_YN, '' AS LAST_POD_STATUS, '0' AS CT_PRINT , '' AS REFERENCE_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PACKING_NO = #{PACKING_NO}

/* PdaCargoMapper.selectHoldInfo : 화물조회 홀드 정보 조회 */ SELECT ISNULL((SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE CODE = HOLD_CODE AND ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND GROUP_CODE='HOLD_CODE' AND USE_YN='Y'), '') AS HOLD_CODE_NAME, HOLD_REASON, HOLD_RELEASE_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{OD_JOB_NO} AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N'

/* PdaCargoMapper.selectCargoTrackingBox : 화물 조회 - 박스 조회 */ SELECT A.BL_NO, A.MBL_NO, A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, A.EX_CT, PKG.PACKING_NO, PKG.DELETE_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG PKG WITH (NOLOCK) ON PKG.IN_PLAN_NO = A.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE A.IN_PLAN_NO = #{inPlanNo}
/* PdaCargoMapper.selectHoldInfoCnt : 화물조회 홀드 정보 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND (CARRYIN_STOP_YN = 'Y' OR CARRYOUT_STOP_YN = 'Y')

/* PdaCargoMapper.selectInitBmsInInfo : 화물 조회 - 출고 후 재입고(반입) 데이터 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 bi.IN_NO , bi.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , CONVERT(CHAR(19), bi.LAST_POD_DATE , 20) AS LAST_POD_DATE , bi.LAST_POD_STATUS , bi.LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS , CONVERT(CHAR(19), bi.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , 20) AS LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , bi.LAST_POD_R48_DATE , bi.IN_CLASS , bi.IN_APPROVAL_NO , bi.TRANS_PERIOD_DATE , bi.OD_JOB_NO , bi.IN_PLAN_NO , bi.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , bi.BL_NO , bi.MBL_NO , bi.CUSTOMS_CODE , bi.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE , bi.INSPECT_YN , bi.NOTICE_INSPECT_YN , bi.LOCATION_PLACE , bi.IMPORT_EXPORT_CLASS , bi.VESSEL_FLIGHT , bi.VOYAGE , bi.AR_DATE , bi.AR_TIME , bi.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , bi.SHIPPER_CODE , bi.SHIPPER_NAME , bi.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1 , bi.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_2 , bi.CONSIGNEE_CODE , bi.CONSIGNEE_NAME , bi.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1 , bi.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(bi.OD_JOB_NO, bi.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID , dbo.Cryptography(bi.OD_JOB_NO, bi.CONSIGNEE_TEL, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , bi.NOTIFY_CODE , bi.NOTIFY_NAME , bi.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_1 , bi.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(bi.OD_JOB_NO, bi.NOTIFY_TEL, 1) AS NOTIFY_TEL , bi.SPECIAL_CODE_1 , bi.SPECIAL_CODE_2 , bi.SPECIAL_CODE_3 , bi.CARRIER_CODE , bi.CNTR_NO , bi.ORIG_COUNTRY , bi.SE_INSPECTION_CODE , bi.SIMPLE_AUTH_NAME , bi.INSPECTION_TYPE , bi.INSPECTION_TYPE_A , bi.INSPECTION_TYPE_B , bi.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , bi.XRAY_LINE_NO , bi.XRAY_CHECK , bi.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , bi.CD_TYPE , bi.ECM_TYPE , bi.CD_USE_TYPE , bi.BIG_SIZE_YN , bi.AMOUNT_USD , bi.XRAY_SCAN_CT , bi.XRAY_IMAGE_CT , bi.CARRYIN_DATE , CONVERT(CHAR(8), CONVERT(DATETIME,bi.CARRYIN_TIME), 24) AS CARRYIN_TIME , bi.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , bi.PERIOD_OVER_DATE , bi.CUSTOMER_CODE , bi.CUSTOMER_NAME , bi.FWD_CODE , bi.FWD_NAME , bi.PKG_TYPE , bi.EX_CT , bi.EX_WT , bi.EX_CBM , bi.CT , bi.WT , bi.CBM , bi.ACCIDENT_CLASS , bi.ACCIDENT_CT , bi.ACCIDENT_WT , bi.ACCIDENT_CBM , bi.STOCK_CT , bi.STOCK_WT , bi.STOCK_CBM , bi.CARRYOUT_DATE , CONVERT(CHAR(8), CONVERT(DATETIME,bi.CARRYOUT_TIME), 24) AS CARRYOUT_TIME , bi.REMARKS_1 AS 'REMARKS1' , bi.REMARKS_2 AS 'REMARKS2' , bi.REMARKS_3 AS 'REMARKS3' , bi.REFERENCE_NO , bi.MGN_ISSUE_YN , bi.REGISTER_USER_ID , (SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = bi.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , bi.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , bi.UPDATE_USER_ID , (SELECT
